original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-ML-general}
Let $I$ be an ideal of a ring $A$. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site.
Let
$$
\ldots \to \mathcal{F}_3 \to \mathcal{F}_2 \to \mathcal{F}_1
$$
be an inverse system of sheaves of $A$-modules on $\mathcal{C}$
such that $\mathcal{F}_n = \mathcal{F}_{n + 1}/I^n\mathcal{F}_{n + 1}$.
Let $p \geq 0$. Assume
$$
\bigoplus\nolimits_{n \geq 0} H^{p + 1}(\mathcal{C}, I^n\mathcal{F}_{n + 1})
$$
satisfies the ascending chain condition as a graded
$\bigoplus_{n \geq 0} I^n/I^{n + 1}$-module.
Then the inverse system $M_n = H^p(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{F}_n)$ satisfies the
Mittag-Leffler condition\footnote{In fact, there exists
a $c \geq 0$ such that $\Im(M_n \to M_{n - c})$ is the stable image
for all $n \geq c$.}.

final_content.statement:
An inverse system $(M_n)$ satisfies the Mittag–Leffler condition when, for every fixed $n$, the images of the transition maps $M_m\to M_n$ stabilize for all sufficiently large $m$. The graded ring $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^n/I^{n+1}$ is the associated graded ring of the $I$-adic filtration. For a site $\mathcal C$ and ring $A$ with ideal $I$, an inverse system of sheaves of $A$-modules $\cdots\to\mathcal F_3\to\mathcal F_2\to\mathcal F_1$ is assumed to have $\mathcal F_n\cong\mathcal F_{n+1}/I^n\mathcal F_{n+1}$. The graded module is built from **degree $p+1$** cohomology of the submodules $I^n\mathcal F_{n+1}$.

hypotheses: $A$ is a ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $\mathcal C$ a site.
$(\mathcal F_n)$ is an inverse system of sheaves of $A$-modules with $\mathcal F_n=\mathcal F_{n+1}/I^n\mathcal F_{n+1}$ for each $n$.
$p\ge0$ and $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}H^{p+1}(\mathcal C,I^n\mathcal F_{n+1})$ satisfies the graded ascending chain condition as a module over $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^n/I^{n+1}$.
conclusions: The inverse system $M_n=H^p(\mathcal C,\mathcal F_n)$ satisfies the Mittag–Leffler condition (indeed eventual stable images admit a uniform shift as in the source footnote).

semantic_review_note: For an inverse system F_n with F_n=F_{n+1}/I^nF_{n+1}, graded ACC of ⊕H^{p+1}(C,I^nF_{n+1}) implies Mittag–Leffler for M_n=H^p(C,F_n); p+1 vs p and uniform stabilization shift footnote maintained.

\label{lemma-ML-general-better}
Let $I$ be an ideal of a ring $A$. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let
$$
\ldots \to \mathcal{F}_3 \to \mathcal{F}_2 \to \mathcal{F}_1
$$
be an inverse system of $A$-modules on $\mathcal{C}$
such that $\mathcal{F}_n = \mathcal{F}_{n + 1}/I^n\mathcal{F}_{n + 1}$.
Let $p \geq 0$. Given $n$ define
$$
N_n =
\bigcap\nolimits_{m \geq n}
\Im\left(
H^{p + 1}(\mathcal{C}, I^n\mathcal{F}_{m + 1}) \to
H^{p + 1}(\mathcal{C}, I^n\mathcal{F}_{n + 1})
\right)
$$
If $\bigoplus N_n$ satisfies the ascending chain condition as a graded
$\bigoplus_{n \geq 0} I^n/I^{n + 1}$-module, then the inverse system
$M_n = H^p(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{F}_n)$ satisfies the Mittag-Leffler
condition\footnote{In fact, there exists
a $c \geq 0$ such that $\Im(M_n \to M_{n - c})$ is the stable image
for all $n \geq c$.}.

An inverse system $(M_n)$ satisfies the Mittag–Leffler condition when, for every fixed $n$, the images of the transition maps $M_m\to M_n$ stabilize for all sufficiently large $m$. The graded ring $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^n/I^{n+1}$ is the associated graded ring of the $I$-adic filtration. For every $n$, set $N_n=\bigcap_{m\ge n}\mathrm{Im}(H^{p+1}(\mathcal C,I^n\mathcal F_{m+1})\to H^{p+1}(\mathcal C,I^n\mathcal F_{n+1}))$. The graded Noetherian/ACC hypothesis is on **$\bigoplus N_n$**, not on the larger direct sum of all degree-$p+1$ cohomology groups; the weaker image condition is essential.

$$
N_n =
\bigcap\nolimits_{m \geq n}
\Im\left(
H^{p + 1}(\mathcal{C}, I^n\mathcal{F}_{m + 1}) \to
H^{p + 1}(\mathcal{C}, I^n\mathcal{F}_{n + 1})
\right)

If $\bigoplus N_n$ satisfies the ascending chain condition as a graded
$\bigoplus_{n \geq 0} I^n/I^{n + 1}$-module, then the inverse system
$M_n = H^p(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{F}_n)$ satisfies the Mittag-Leffler
condition\footnote{In fact, there exists

hypotheses: $I$ is an ideal of a ring $A$, and $\mathcal C$ is a site.
$(\mathcal F_n)$ is an inverse system of sheaves of $A$-modules with $\mathcal F_n=\mathcal F_{n+1}/I^n\mathcal F_{n+1}$.
$p\ge0$, $N_n$ is the intersection of the specified images for all $m\ge n$, and the graded module $\bigoplus_n N_n$ satisfies ACC over $\bigoplus_n I^n/I^{n+1}$.
conclusions: The inverse system $M_n=H^p(\mathcal C,\mathcal F_n)$ satisfies the Mittag–Leffler condition.

semantic_review_note: The refined Mittag–Leffler criterion requires graded ACC only on ⊕N_n where N_n is the INTERSECTION of images of H^{p+1}(C,I^n F_{m+1}) as m≥n, retaining this weaker hypothesis instead of replacing it by ACC of all cohomology.
